Hurewicz determines all 6-cell attaching maps and the cellular cancellations yield precisely four 5-spheres and 139 6-spheres. Actual packaged checker replays the construction, not only a stored log.

value.rationale: This is the complete integral homotopy classification of the canonical 3-cube ordinary Morse complex, a known nontrivial 23,625-face case previously classified only over F2. The explicit integral attaching-degree calculation rules out torsion and nontrivial attachments, establishing a meaningful mixed-dimensional homotopy type not implied by the previous field Betti vector and of direct use as a benchmark for graph Morse complexes.
